map.输入材料类型、回收率与能耗，计算可回收指数、碳减排与环境效益: Enter material type, recovery rate and energy consumption to compute recyclability index, carbon reduction and environmental benefit
map.回收环境收益 = (原生能耗 − 再生能耗) × 回收质量: Recycling environmental benefit = (virgin energy minus recycled energy) times recycled mass
map.基于可回收性评估：以材料质量、回收率与再生能耗相对原生能耗的节约量，量化回收环境: Based on recyclability assessment: from material mass, recovery rate and the saving of recycled energy relative to virgin energy, quantify recycling environmental benefit, for circular economy evaluation.
map.💡 可回收指数 = 回收率 × (1 - 再生能耗/原生能耗) × 100；碳减: Recyclability index = recovery rate times (1 minus recycled energy / virgin energy) times 100; carbon reduction = energy saving times 0.5 kgCO2 / kWh

map.📚 深度解析：可回收性评估（节能/碳减排/可回收指数）: In-depth: Recyclability Assessment (energy saving / carbon reduction / recyclability index)
map.绿色选材：对比不同材料回收的节能与碳减排收益: Green material selection: compare the energy saving and carbon reduction benefit of different material recycling
map.产品 LCA：量化回收环节的环境效益评分: Product LCA: quantify the environmental benefit score of the recycling stage
map.宣传换算：把碳减排折算为等效种树与等效里程: Publicity conversion: convert carbon reduction into equivalent tree planting and equivalent mileage
map.算法：回收质量 = 总质量×回收率/100；节能 = 回收质量×(原生能耗 −: Algorithm: recycled mass = total mass times recovery rate / 100; energy saving = recycled mass times (virgin energy minus recycled energy) (kWh); carbon reduction = energy saving times 0.5 (kgCO2); recyclability index = recovery rate / 100 times (1 minus recycled energy / virgin energy) times 100; environmental benefit score = recyclability index times 0.6 + (energy saving / (total mass times virgin energy)) times 0.4 times 100, upper bound 100; equivalent trees = carbon reduction / 18 (trees / year); equivalent mileage = carbon reduction / 0.12 (km). Grade greater than or equal to 70 is A, greater than or equal to 50 B, greater than or equal to 30 C, otherwise D. Switching material auto-fills the default recovery rate and virgin / recycled energy of that material.
map.例：铝合金（默认原生 14、再生 2 kWh/kg、回收率 80%）100kg: Example: aluminum alloy (default virgin 14, recycled 2 kWh/kg, recovery rate 80%) 100 kg gives recycled mass 80 kg, energy saving 960 kWh, carbon reduction 480 kg, recyclability index 68.6, environmental score 69, equivalent trees 26.7, equivalent mileage 4000 km, grade B. Steel (virgin 6, recycled 1.8, recovery rate 90%) 100 kg gives recycled 90 kg, energy saving 378 kWh, carbon reduction 189 kg, index 63.0, score 63, grade B. Composite (virgin 10, recycled 6, recovery rate 25%) gives recycled 25 kg, energy saving 100 kWh, index only 10, score 10, grade D.
map.原生/再生能耗差为什么是关键？: Why is the virgin / recycled energy difference key?
map.再生的减排收益来自被替代的原生冶炼能耗。铝的原生电解能耗高（约 14kWh/kg: The recycling emission reduction benefit comes from the replaced virgin smelting energy. Aluminum virgin electrolytic energy is high (about 14 kWh/kg), recycled only about 2 kWh/kg, the difference 12 kWh/kg is huge, so aluminum recycling has the highest value; composite recycled energy is close to virgin and recovery rate is low, so it scores lowest.
map.0.5 kgCO₂/kWh 与 18kg/棵怎么来的？: How do 0.5 kgCO2 / kWh and 18 kg / tree come from?
map.前者为电网排放因子的简化取值，后者为单棵树年固碳量的常用估算，均用于直观换算。做: The former is a simplified grid emission factor; the latter is a common estimate of a single tree annual carbon sequestration, both used for intuitive conversion. For a formal ESG report, replace with the latest published emission factor of the project location.
